# Draft:David Frye (historian)

David Frye is a professor of history at the University of Michigan who specializes in European history and is the author of the book Walls: A History of Civilization in Blood and Brick.
Fry is also an occasional contributor to Science Channel, CNBC, National Geographic, the History Channel, BBC Radio, The Washington Post, Rolling Stone and other factual media outlets.
